result.title: Protected Unbiased Sparsification: A Sharp Loewner Curve
result.comment: 44 pages, 11 figures. Code, protocols, and saved results are included as ancillary files
result.summary: Random sparsification replaces a probability vector by a random vector with few nonzero entries. We ask for unbiasedness, exact preservation of prescribed linear statistics, and a covariance guarantee for every downstream linear response. Let $p$ have $k$ positive coordinates, let $A$ specify the protected statistics, and let $d\le k-2$ be their effective rank. For every $d+1\le m\le k$, we construct an unbiased random probability vector $Q$ with at most $m$ nonzero coordinates, $AQ=Ap$ on every realization, and $\operatorname{Cov}(Q)\preceq h C_{p\mid A}$, where $h=(k-m)/((m-d)(k-d-1))$ and $C_{p\mid A}$ is the categorical covariance after optimal linear adjustment for the protected statistics. This coefficient is sharp uniformly over instances, even among biased estimators when error is measured by its second moment. A residual covariance bridge extends the concurrent unprotected curve to arbitrary pathwise linear protection. We also characterize instance-optimal constants for partitions with uniform weights within classes and derive bounds for peaked weights. For rational inputs, an exact Las Vegas sampler attains the curve within a factor $1+ε$ in expected polynomial time. A separate fast block-pivotal sampler preserves block masses and is no worse in covariance order than independent sampling within blocks. Experiments illustrate the theory on synthetic weights and language-model attention. In Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct decoding, the fast sampler preserves block masses, while comparisons with VarOpt remain statistically inconclusive and top-$m$ truncation scores highest on RULER.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究带「受保护统计量」的无偏随机稀疏化：在保持指定线性统计逐实现精确不变的前提下，构造至多 m 个非零分量的随机概率向量，给出协方差在 Loewner 序下的锐利系数，并提供精确与快速采样器及注意力/解码上的示例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其无偏稀疏采样与协方差可控性可能为 latent 状态或视觉证据的随机筛选提供方差与保真度的评价视角，文中注意力解码实验可供核查，但与视觉推理主线无直接关联。
